snippet.title: MR. MEAT OFFICIAL TEASER 🐷🍖
snippet.description:
It's been almost 6 years since the release of Mr. Meat 🍖 Time flies when you're turning humans into pigs! And we wanted to conmemorate this iconic horror games by bringing you an official teaser, it was about time! 🐽

MR MEAT 🍖   
🔸Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kalipsogames.psychopathhunt 
🔹App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/mr-meat-horror-escape-room/id1457272452
